scope: Open WebUI guarded chat, XRPL Testnet RLUSD supplier payments, scheduling, payment/ledger history, owner controls and audit

rubric.0: Absent beyond prose; no implemented capability.
rubric.50: Substantive partial implementation; known acceptance gaps.
rubric.75: Merged bounded implementation with automated test sources; integration/operational proof remains.
rubric.100: Acceptance complete with retained evidence appropriate to capability, including live product path where required.

tickets.title: Workspace, agent and initial fixtures
tickets.current_state: Node/pnpm workspace and existing agent sources are on main.
tickets.acceptance: Fresh install, typecheck and targeted tests reproduce on the supported runtime.

tickets.title: CI and secret/path guardrails
tickets.current_state: Pinned workflows, scanner and tracked-path guard exist; R2 remains SEC01.
tickets.acceptance: Retain the current CI checks; close scanner bypass separately under SEC01.

tickets.title: Shared contracts, money and audit primitives
tickets.current_state: Shared schemas, bigint cents and canonical hashes exist.
tickets.acceptance: Consumers import shared contracts; contract integration is C01, not implied by this library.

tickets.title: Product rename to Shucamoxa
tickets.current_state: Rename landed; older history remains historical.
tickets.acceptance: Current source imports use @shucamoxa naming.

tickets.title: Bind invoice payments to code-resolved supplier
tickets.current_state: Supplier binding and confidence threshold exist; extraction spoofing is T06b.
tickets.acceptance: Preserve supplier-ID/confidence attack regressions.

tickets.title: Bind approvals and supplier proposals to invoice
tickets.current_state: Bound requests and one-per-kind restrictions exist; no production approval UI.
tickets.acceptance: Preserve exact invoice/amount/supplier binding; real decisions remain T31/T32.

tickets.title: Ground extraction and neutralise invoice tags
tickets.current_state: Initial grounding/normalisation implemented; sender/items bypasses remain T06b.
tickets.acceptance: Keep unicode/template/amount boundary regressions; do not call all grounding solved.

tickets.title: Minimise planner input and bound free text
tickets.current_state: plannerView and bounded reasons implemented; tool-read projections need SEC02.
tickets.acceptance: Descriptions/suspicious-text canaries stay out of planner; revalidate all read outputs.

tickets.title: Agent environment and backend-origin checks
tickets.current_state: Startup checks reject key-shaped values and unsafe backend origins.
tickets.acceptance: No unsafe bypass flag; credentials never appear in errors.

tickets.title: Timeouts, redirects and response-size limits
tickets.current_state: Bounded calls, redirect rejection and conservative payment-unknown handling exist.
tickets.acceptance: Keep no-retry unknown behavior and redirect credential-isolation tests.

tickets.title: Authenticated invoice HTTP agent service
tickets.current_state: /health, /agent/invoices, serial queue and ownerChat seam are on main.
tickets.acceptance: Retain auth/body-limit/duplicate-inflight tests; chat transport remains T13.

tickets.title: Explicit development mock backend
tickets.current_state: Five agent API routes and contract tests exist; hashes/state are simulated.
tickets.acceptance: Keep SHUCAMOXA_MOCK opt-in and visible mock labeling; never count as settlement.

tickets.title: Demo invoice PDFs and red-team fixtures
tickets.current_state: Fixture generation and expected outcomes exist.
tickets.acceptance: Retain deterministic fixtures; live-model replay remains T17.

tickets.title: Finish sender and text-line-item grounding
tickets.current_state: Branch implementation exists; review notes identify skipped digit lines, negative/credit handling and sender-block ambiguity.
tickets.acceptance: Fail closed for notes impersonation, empty/invented items, skipped digit lines, negative/CR/DR items and duplicate/misplaced From blocks; rerun fixtures 09/10 and LLM-07 before integrating.

tickets.title: Reconcile merged chat guards with outstanding review
tickets.current_state: Base chat guards merged; later handoff still reports currency/payee parsing blockers.
tickets.acceptance: Reproduce every currency case and ambiguous/negated payee example; reject unsupported/ambiguous currency and payee; one payment attempt; deterministic summary. Do not replace a settled record with a generic model error.

tickets.title: Mutation hardening and typed tool-read outputs
tickets.current_state: Archived mutation review predates fixes; no fresh mutation score found.
tickets.acceptance: Reproduce surviving mutants; validate Rules/SupplierLookup/LogFilter and read results; cover redaction, temperature/retries and mid-run kill switch; publish dated mutation results without reusing old scores.

tickets.title: OpenAI-compatible guarded-agent chat adapter
tickets.current_state: ownerChat accepts latestOwnerTurn in-process; no HTTP chat adapter.
tickets.evidence: services/agent/src/server.ts; latest handoff supersedes archived T13 SSE design
tickets.acceptance: Expose authenticated /v1/chat/completions and model discovery for Open WebUI; derive authority only from latest authenticated owner turn; retain shared queue, deadlines and deterministic payment summary; ignore forged history/system/tool authority. Safe disconnect/stream errors must preserve unknown or settled results.

tickets.title: Bounded PDF intake and invoice CLI fallback
tickets.current_state: PDF fixtures are generated; invoice service accepts text, not PDF parsing.
tickets.acceptance: Exactly one text/PDF input; verify PDF magic, 2MB decoded/5-page/10s limits; encrypted/no-text goes to review; feed identical guarded path; CLI token from environment. Test normalisation parity on fixture PDFs.

tickets.title: Repeatable real-model finance evaluation
tickets.current_state: Opt-in tests and fixtures exist; no current qualified finance run on local Qwen.
tickets.acceptance: Pinned model/prompt/tool revisions; fixtures 01-14 and history/payment/refused-policy-change chat; repeated runs with decision, actual calls, exact amounts, latency and failures; never count model claims as payment evidence.

tickets.title: Local model smoke gate and shared prompts
tickets.current_state: User supplied local Qwen chat output; finance tool reliability not demonstrated.
tickets.evidence: scripts/model-smoke-test.ts; local chat supplied by user
tickets.acceptance: Use selected local model, shared production prompts and actual tool schemas; record digest/context/latency; prove harmless repository read first and guarded mock pay next. No hosted fallback required unless team chooses it.

tickets.title: Conditional simplified approval toolset
tickets.current_state: Only needed if measured model confusion justifies it.
tickets.acceptance: Implement only after failed tool-selection evidence; preserve all T05 bindings.

tickets.title: Independent co-signer: auth and signed-byte verification
tickets.current_state: Cosign schemas and coordinator policy interface exist; no service implementation.
tickets.acceptance: Isolated Testnet signer authenticates payment service only; decode actual blob, verify expected signer/signature and canonical equality; enforce Payment/treasury; sign exactly checked bytes, never mutable caller JSON; fail closed on exceptions/log failure.

tickets.title: Strict XRPL payment transaction checks
tickets.current_state: No deployed policy check pipeline found.
tickets.acceptance: Allowlist type/fields/flags; cap Fee; exact genuine test RLUSD issuer/currency/cents and approved destination/tag; forbid partial payment/DEX routing; exactly bound memo and expiry. Test every substitution and non-Payment type offline with real generated keys.

tickets.title: Atomic budgets, duplicate protection and reservation lifecycle
tickets.current_state: SQLite coordinator has reservations/deduplication; not integrated into a real cosign service.
tickets.acceptance: Use one authoritative durable reservation state; concurrent requests cannot overspend; no second submit per obligation; retain unknown reservations across timeout/restart. Replace archived unconditional TTL release with proven definitive rejection/expiry rules.

tickets.title: Policy version, stale-ledger, memo and rate checks
tickets.current_state: Policy versions are checked in coordinator; final transaction/memo/ledger checks absent.
tickets.acceptance: Recheck policy/kill switch/reservation at signing and before submission; current < LastLedgerSequence <= current+20; exact unused pending-entry memo; bounded rate window. Durable payment safety cannot depend on a resettable in-memory counter.

tickets.title: Policy decision audit and hostile replay
tickets.current_state: Adversarial missing-control tests exist; no real co-signer path to replay.
tickets.acceptance: Audit allowed and blocked decisions before releasing signature; no audit write means no sign; replay fixtures and transaction attacks through actual service, including direct calls without agent.

tickets.title: Fresh Testnet RLUSD treasury and recovery-safe multisig
tickets.current_state: feat/testnet has separate fresh-wallet 1-XRP demo; RLUSD multisig treasury setup absent.
tickets.evidence: feat/testnet@9f94e53; services/backend/src/; reported XRP hash in branch status
tickets.acceptance: Testnet guard; trusted issuer and trustlines; establish recovery before master disable; verify signer list/quorum and no alternate key bypass. Generate keys at runtime, isolate service stores, print no seeds; prove RLUSD delivered_amount with a validated transaction.

tickets.title: Real wallet adapter, transaction build/sign/submit/reconcile
tickets.current_state: Durable coordinator implemented; wallet.submit/lookup and policy.authorize are interfaces.
tickets.acceptance: Persist final transaction/hash/signing attempt before send; no post-approval mutation; verify policy signature and identical bytes; exact validated delivered_amount/issuer/destination/tag; unknown stays reserved and reconciles on restart without replacement transfer.

tickets.title: Kill switch and ledger revocation evidence
tickets.current_state: Coordinator flag/lockout exists; no ledger revoke/restore flow.
tickets.acceptance: Owner-only revoke/restore; recheck in-flight policy; document already-submitted transaction limits; capture ledger signer state and actual agent-only/master-key/revoked-signer submission rejections. Non-applied tef failures need RPC+ledger-state evidence, not a fictitious validated failure hash. Fix archived contradictory resume ordering by testing one fail-closed state machine.

tickets.title: Extend durable storage and versioned migrations
tickets.current_state: Coordinator SQLite exists; business invoices/rules/suppliers/approvals API persistence incomplete.
tickets.acceptance: Reuse existing coordinator rather than duplicate budgets; persist tenant-bound invoices, suppliers, policy versions, approvals, attempts and audit; migration/restart/concurrency tests; exact cents; agent cannot access database.

tickets.title: Durable multi-service audit writer and verification
tickets.current_state: Shared chain and payment audit gate exist; mock log in memory; external writer/anchors incomplete.
tickets.acceptance: Serialized appends across processes; log allow/block/unknown/settle and owner changes; owner-only bounded export; preserve canonical schema. A locally valid chain alone cannot prove no suffix deletion or complete rewrite; complete H02 before claiming that.

tickets.title: Authenticated real agent-facing API and status/history reads
tickets.current_state: T15 mock has five routes; MCP /v1 and /transfers differ; production API missing.
tickets.acceptance: One explicit versioned route/status/role map; real storage + coordinator; request schemas and bounded projections; agentApiContract passes; least-privilege token denied every owner route; transport error cannot imply payment failed or safely retryable.

tickets.title: Owner-only mandate, suppliers, approval and kill-switch API
tickets.current_state: Core owner credential restrictions exist; full owner login/decision API absent.
tickets.acceptance: Owner auth/session/Origin/CSRF/expiry plus narrow script credentials; versioned rules; supplier address/tag changes require independent re-verification; auditable decisions; no model/WebUI inference token carries owner authority.

tickets.title: Single-use owner-approved exception payment
tickets.current_state: Approval request schemas and core owner exceptions exist; complete signing flow absent.
tickets.acceptance: Approve exact obligation/recipient/amount/version/expiry once; owner signs outside agent/API; verify returned bytes and identity; budget accounting includes owner payments; distinguish owner authority from independent policy enforcement.

tickets.title: Harden Open WebUI workspace and owner-session boundary
tickets.current_state: Compose and user-local chat exist; image uses mutable main tag; finance auth separate.
tickets.acceptance: Use Open WebUI baseline rather than rebuild archived Next.js chat; pin reviewed image digest; restrict unnecessary direct connections/web loading/code execution; private binding and separate owner controls. Review version-specific advisories; no claim installed version is vulnerable without evidence.

tickets.title: Owner control surface for rules, suppliers and approvals
tickets.current_state: Generic WebUI settings are not finance owner controls.
tickets.acceptance: Small authenticated owner UI or companion view; show cap/budget/spent/reserved, approved payees and pending decisions; render untrusted evidence literally; re-verification workflow; no owner writes as model tools.

tickets.title: Owner kill-switch and trustworthy activity view
tickets.current_state: No integrated activity/kill-switch screen found.
tickets.acceptance: Immediate stop-new-payments control; explicit submitted/unknown limits; independent verify/export; safe Testnet links only; distinguish chain continuity from external anchoring and complete ledger history. Paginated windows need checkpoint context, not verifyChain on reversed newest-first rows.

tickets.title: Connect Open WebUI chat and invoice upload to guarded agent
tickets.current_state: Local general chat works; no repo-finance connector registered.
tickets.acceptance: Configure adapter as guarded agent endpoint; WebUI cannot bypass it via raw pay MCP. Upload passes bounded intake; deterministic payment record visibly separate from model prose; demonstrate authenticated read then mock payment before live Testnet.

tickets.title: Cross-service baseline acceptance and Testnet evidence
tickets.current_state: Agent/mock/core tests and adversarial suite exist; full deployed pipeline unproved.
tickets.acceptance: Boot actual services against temporary DB, verify authority and concurrency attacks; then fresh-wallet Testnet RLUSD allowed/blocked/scheduled/history journeys with sanitized evidence. Simulator results labeled simulated; tef failure proof separate from validated success. Never invent passing policy implementation inside tests.

tickets.title: Current runbook, evidence-backed pitch and demo package
tickets.current_state: Docs and supporting statement exist; commands/status and final evidence need reconciliation.
tickets.acceptance: Update active docs and remove retired commands; one-command local stack with explicit mock/Testnet modes; cite exact SHA/results; verify official submission requirements separately. State tested against only; no infallibility/certification/legal or Sharia approval claims.

tickets.title: Freeze one invoice-to-intent and API contract
tickets.current_state: Three incompatible contracts exist; archived hybrid recommendation is not implemented.
tickets.evidence: MCP README; shared transfers.ts; archived contract-conflict.md; audit P2
tickets.acceptance: Xhanti writes route/status/role map; Tran signs off execution, Cameron signs off client. Persist grounded trusted payable and immutable ID; narrowly scoped intake may register obligation but cannot set policy/recipient/unlock/approve. Model pay carries ID, not arbitrary payee/amount; dedupe across invoice revisions and UI retries.

tickets.title: Align MCP tools with selected guarded backend
tickets.current_state: Seven stdio tools and strict two-tool transfer entry point exist; not attached to real backend/WebUI.
tickets.acceptance: Contract tests cover canonical backend, error/unknown/status handling, scoped auth, output allowlists and extra-field refusal. Keep optional raw finance MCP for separately authorized clients; baseline WebUI uses guarded T13 agent, not direct payment tool access.

tickets.title: Owner scheduling/cancel/reschedule tools and records
tickets.current_state: Core executeAt exists; no bounded chat schedule/cancel/status journey.
tickets.evidence: services/payments/src/payment.ts; user baseline overrides old scheduling exclusion
tickets.acceptance: Authenticated owner request binds trusted intent, amount/payee, timezone and UTC due instant; clarify ambiguous date/time and confirm interpretation; cancel/reschedule cannot race execution or change settled/unknown history. Agent cannot create arbitrary authority; persist scheduling changes and responses.

tickets.title: Deploy durable due-payment worker and recovery
tickets.current_state: executeDue and /transfers/due exist; no deployed timer/worker.
tickets.acceptance: Bounded authenticated worker; due-time policy/kill/recipient/expiry checks, atomic claim and restart-safe once-only execution. Two workers and repeated timer ticks cannot duplicate; unknown retains reservation; surface missed/delayed/cancelled status.

tickets.title: Payment/transaction history and balance tools
tickets.current_state: query_log and legacy balance/status adapters exist; complete validated XRPL history absent.
tickets.acceptance: Paginated, tenant-authorized status/history and genuine RLUSD balance from validated ledger; distinguish intent/audit/settled/on-chain events; include incoming/out-of-band transactions for selected treasury, ledger cursor/reconnect/dedupe; bounded filters and privacy-safe results. Live answers reference actual records/hashes, never model memory.

tickets.title: Independent audit heads and ledger memo verifier
tickets.current_state: Local chain detects many edits but not full rewrite/suffix deletion without independent head.
tickets.acceptance: Persist authenticated checkpoints outside payment DB; match actual payment memo to durable request entry; detect deletion/rollback/full recomputation against checkpoint; disclose unanchored blocked-event suffixes. Never expose invoice or personal data in memo.

tickets.title: Close secret scanner hash-label bypass (R2)
tickets.current_state: Raw 64-hex exemption for hash/digest/checksum remains open.
tickets.acceptance: Real scanner regressions catch runtime canary with deceptive labels/comments; exact legitimate hashes remain usable; no real secrets; CI remains green without relaxing scanner.

tickets.title: Bound and sanitise every tool-read response
tickets.current_state: Address redaction/minimisation exists; backend dictionaries/free-text paths need typed projection.
tickets.acceptance: Strict schemas and field allowlists for log/rules/supplier/status/balance; canary credentials and untrusted instruction strings never reach next model prompt/logs/errors; owner detail view separate. Test TS and Python paths.

tickets.title: Isolate keys/services and record current security evidence
tickets.current_state: Config guards/tests exist; actual runtime filesystem/network/key isolation not proved.
tickets.acceptance: Separate signer/agent/policy identities and storage; no signer seeds in WebUI/agent; private binds and no public model/tool ports; exercise restart/restore and compromised-agent containment; rerun current adversarial suite on pinned runtime and retain SHA/results. Deployment dependency blocks final closure, not the initial isolation plan.

tickets.title: Firefox/Chrome sidebar extension
tickets.current_state: Requested later, no extension implementation found.
tickets.acceptance: Only after baseline acceptance; scoped read-only page intake/explicit actions and same guarded authority boundary.

tickets.title: Broader banking, FX, escrow, yield and commercial rollout
tickets.current_state: Roadmap aspirations and governance research; not baseline banking parity.
tickets.acceptance: Separate product requirements and legal/custody/Sharia review when applicable; no bank/compliance certification claims from Testnet.
